description: Compare two files, e.g. a raw file and its export: metadata differences, geometry, channel names, physical sizes, and per-plane hashes or the largest difference within tolerance. identical says whether they hold the same data.

against.description: The second file (e.g. an OME-TIFF export of `file`).

file.description: The first file (e.g. the raw file).

ignore.description: JSON pointers (into openreadout_info output) to leave out of the metadata diff; `*` matches one segment.

image.description: Only this image index (in both files).

level.description: Pyramid level (0 = full resolution, the default).

no_pixels.description: Metadata and geometry only, no pixels.

select.description: Plane selection strings such as `c=0`, `z=2-5`, `t=0,3`. A second file holding only the selected planes (an export with the same selection) is matched to them in order.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

tolerance.description: Largest absolute sample difference that still counts as equal. Default: bit-identical planes (same xxh3-128).

name: openreadout_compare

Difference.description: A value that differs, at an RFC 6901 JSON pointer into `info --json` `data`.

ours.description: Value in the first file; absent when the first file lacks the field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer to the value, e.g. `/images/0/physical_size/x`.

theirs.description: Value in the second file; absent when the second file lacks the field.

ImageComparison.description: One image index present in either file.

geometry_equal.description:
Both files have the image and their geometries agree (with `selected`, after the
selection).

ours.description: Absent when the first file has no image with this index.

ours_channels.description: Channel names of the first file (listed only when they differ).

ours_physical_size.description: Physical pixel size in the first file (listed only when the sizes differ).

physical_size_equal.description: Physical sizes agree to a relative 1e-6 (both absent counts as equal).

selected.description:
The second file holds only the selected planes of this image (an export made with the
same selection): planes, channels and the metadata diff were matched in selection
order, and `ours` is the geometry after the selection.

theirs.description: Absent when the second file has no image with this index.

theirs_channels.description: Channel names of the second file (listed only when they differ).

theirs_physical_size.description: Physical pixel size in the second file (listed only when the sizes differ).

difference_count.description: Total number of differences (the list holds at most 1000).

equal.description: True when no difference was found.

ignored.description:
Pointers left out (defaults plus `--ignore`); `extra` objects are also left out unless
`include_extra`.

PhysicalSize.description: Physical pixel size in micrometres (the OME default unit). Every present value is > 0.

x.description: Pixel width in µm (the distance between neighbouring columns).

y.description: Pixel height in µm (the distance between neighbouring rows).

z.description: Spacing between Z planes (focal slices) in µm.

PixelType.description: Sample type of one channel value. Names follow OME-XML `PixelType` values.

oneOf.description: Unsigned 16-bit integer (the usual microscope camera output).
Complex number of two 32-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `complex`.
Complex number of two 64-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `double-complex`.

mismatched.description: Planes that differ beyond the tolerance (or at all, without one).

mismatches.description: At most 1000 entries, in plane order.

skipped_images.description: Image indices not compared plane by plane (missing on one side or geometry differs).

within_tolerance.description: Planes that differ but within the tolerance.

differing_samples.description: Samples that differ (absent when the planes' shapes differ).

max_abs_diff.description: Largest absolute difference between corresponding samples.

note.description: Why the samples could not be compared (e.g. the plane shapes differ).

ours_xxh3.description: xxh3-128 of the plane in the first file.

theirs_xxh3.description: xxh3-128 of the plane in the second file.

within_tolerance.description: With a tolerance: whether `max_abs_diff` is within it (then the plane counts as equal).

identical.description:
Nothing compared differs: metadata (unless skipped), geometry, channel names,
physical sizes and planes (within the tolerance). The exit code is 0 when true, 1
when false.

images.description: Geometry, channel-name and physical-size comparison per image index.

notes.description: Caveats (e.g. formats that store different metadata for the same acquisition).
